title.en: Add the latest Play release to daily real-user QA
title.zh: 每日真实用户 QA 覆盖最新边玩边学版本

purpose.en: Make the 3 AM real-user acceptance cycle verify both Play entry points, every activity tile, the language picker, and target-language propagation after each release.
purpose.zh: 让每天凌晨 3 点的真实用户验收在每次发布后检查两个边玩边学入口、全部玩法卡、语言选择器及目标语言传递。

en: Activate both the shared-header Play link and the home Today-task image during every daily production run.
Verify the Chinese interface default, all six activity tiles, and the twelve-language picker.
Verify English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian propagate into every language-dependent Play link before completing SmartCard practice.
zh: 每日正式站测试都会实际点击共享导航和首页今日任务图片两个独立入口。
检查中文界面默认语言、全部六张玩法卡和十二种语言选择器。
完成智慧卡练习前，检查英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语是否传递到所有相关玩法链接。
凌晨 3 点本机真实用户 QA

en: Extend the recovery prompt with observable production acceptance criteria for both Play entry points.
Make the QA contract fail if any of the six activities, the twelve-language picker, or target-language continuity is omitted.
Keep the existing signed-in course, speech, scoring, persistence, repair, deployment, and retest cycle unchanged.
zh: 在恢复任务提示中加入两个边玩边学入口的可观察正式站验收标准。
若六种玩法、十二种语言选择器或目标语言连续性有任何缺失，QA 合同会失败。
保留已有登录课程、语音、评分、持久化、修复、发布和复测闭环。

en: TypeScript, changed-file ESLint, sensitive-data scan, and the production build pass.
The full repository suite passes after updating the intentional Course-before-College contract.
WebKit runtime layout passes 260/260 checks across 26 routes, Chinese and English, and five phone, iPad, and desktop viewports.
Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and all 11 SmartLingo shared contracts pass.
zh: TypeScript、本次文件 ESLint、敏感数据扫描和正式构建通过。
更新明确的课程先于学院合同后，全仓测试通过。
WebKit 运行布局通过 260/260 项：26 个路由、中英文和 5 种手机、iPad、桌面尺寸。
共享政策、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 全部 11 项共享合同通过。

en: Automated production browser QA cannot provide a real human speech sample; it verifies navigation and the microphone-ready state without inventing a pronunciation score.
zh: 自动正式站浏览器验收无法提供真人语音样本；它会验证导航与麦克风就绪状态，但不会伪造发音成绩。

en: This release changes SmartLingo learning discovery only and does not alter other portfolio sites or their navigation.
zh: 本次只调整 SmartLingo 学习入口，不改变其他站点及其导航。
